verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents OAuth-gated authorization for its admin MCP server (mcp.mintlify.com returns 401 with Bearer/OAuth metadata) but there is no documentation of a mechanism for users to mint scoped, least-privilege API keys/tokens for agents with configurable permission levels. Community evidence actually shows the opposite pattern in practice: the GitHub app integration requests access to all repos with 'no way to get around that,' i.e., no granular/least-privilege option was available to at least one customer.
